We capture reality.
Then we engineer it.

VShark Solutions provides state-of-the-art 3D scanning and 3D design services for businesses and individuals. We capture parts, products and spaces as accurate digital data — then engineer that data into editable CAD, flawless surfaces, BIM models, inspection reports, prototypes and photoreal visuals. One partner, from the physical object to the finished digital deliverable and back again.

01

Our services

Use one on its own, or hand us the whole job.

013D Scanning

Capture any part, product or space as an accurate digital model.

Point cloud (.PLY, .TXT) · Mesh (.STL, .OBJ) · Colour/texture scans

02Reverse Engineering

Turn scan data into fully editable, manufacturable CAD.

Parametric CAD (.STEP, .IGES, .X_T) · Native SolidWorks / Creo / NX · 2D drawings (.PDF, .DWG)

03Scan to BIM

Existing buildings captured as accurate, intelligent BIM models.

Registered point cloud (.E57, .RCP) · Revit model (.RVT) · IFC export

04Class A Surfacing

Flawless, curvature-continuous surfaces for visible parts.

Class A surfaces (.IGES, .STEP) · Native Alias / ICEM models · Surface-analysis reports

05Digital Metrology

Compare manufactured parts to their CAD — to the micron.

Inspection report (.PDF) · Colour deviation maps · GD&T results tables

063D Printing

Rapid prototypes and functional parts, straight from your model.

Printed parts · Print-ready files (.STL, .3MF) · Finishing / painting on request

07Product Rendering

Photoreal visuals that sell a product before it is ever made.

High-res stills (.PNG, .TIFF) · Animations (.MP4) · 360° turntables

End-to-end, one partner

Scan, engineer, inspect, print and render under one roof — with one point of contact.

02

How we work

Scan to solution in four steps.

Step 01Capture

We scan the part, product or site — in our lab or on location.

Step 02Process

Scans are aligned, cleaned and merged into usable, watertight data.

Step 03Engineer

CAD, Class A surfaces, BIM or inspection built from that data.

Step 04Deliver

Native files, drawings and reports in the formats your team uses.
